inputs.name: CS v2 zero density

lean.exact_source_statement:
def CSv2 : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Fin 12) (σ T : ℝ),
    (16 + (i.val : ℝ)) / 32 ≤ σ → σ ≤ (17 + (i.val : ℝ)) / 32 →
    3000000000000 ≤ T →
    (densityZeroCount σ T : ℝ) ≤
      csB1 i * T ^ csExponent σ * (Real.log T) ^ csLogExponent σ +
      csB2 i * (Real.log T) ^ 2 + csB3 i * Real.log T

inputs.mathematical_statement: For each row j=16,...,27, all real sigma in [j/32,(j+1)/32], and all real T>=3000000000000: N(sigma,T)<=B1*T^(3*(1-sigma)/(2-sigma))*log(T)^((7-5*sigma)/(2-sigma))+B2*log(T)^2+B3*log(T).

supporting_lean_definitions.csExponent:
noncomputable def csExponent (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := 3 * (1 - σ) / (2 - σ)
noncomputable def csLogExponent (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := (7 - 5 * σ) / (2 - σ)
supporting_lean_definitions.csLogExponent: noncomputable def csLogExponent (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := (7 - 5 * σ) / (2 - σ)

inputs.name: Integrated explicit formula

lean.exact_source_statement:
def IntegratedExplicitFormula : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → Tendsto (integratedZeroSum t) atTop (𝓝 (integratedFormulaValue t))

inputs.mathematical_statement: For each real x>1, lim_{T->+infinity} sum_{rho in Z(T)} m(rho)*x^(rho+1)/(rho*(rho+1)) = x^2/2-(zeta_prime(0)/zeta(0))*x+zeta_prime(-1)/zeta(-1)-V(x)-Psi1(x), as a complex limit.

definitions.Z(T): All nontrivial open-strip zeros with abs(Im(rho))<=T, including zero height in the definition.

supporting_lean_definitions.integratedZeroSum:
noncomputable def integratedZeroSum (t T : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ ρ ∈ allZetaZeros T, (zetaMultiplicity ρ : ℂ) * zeroPrimitive ρ t
supporting_lean_definitions.trivialZeroPrimitiveSum:
noncomputable def trivialZeroPrimitiveSum (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' j : ℕ, zeroPrimitive (-2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) t
supporting_lean_definitions.integratedFormulaValue:
noncomputable def integratedFormulaValue (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 - (deriv riemannZeta 0 / riemannZeta 0) * (t : ℂ) +
    deriv riemannZeta (-1) / riemannZeta (-1) - trivialZeroPrimitiveSum t -
    (integratedPsi t : ℂ)

inputs.name: CHJII shared-truncation explicit formula

lean.exact_source_statement:
def CHJIIShortInterval : Prop :=
  ∀ (x h T : ℝ), 0 < x → 40 ≤ Real.log x → 0 ≤ h →
    max 51 ((Real.log x) ^ 2) < T → T < (Real.sqrt x - 2) / 4 →
    ∃ Tstar : ℝ, T ≤ Tstar ∧ Tstar ≤ 2 * T ∧
      ‖((Chebyshev.psi (x + h) - Chebyshev.psi x - h : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        truncatedZeroIncrement x (x + h) Tstar‖ ≤
        (1447 / 500 : ℝ) / T * ((x + h) * Real.log (x + h) + x * Real.log x)

inputs.mathematical_statement: For real x,h,T with x>0, log(x)>=40, h>=0, max(51,log(x)^2)<T<(sqrt(x)-2)/4, there exists real Tstar in [T,2*T] with norm(psi(x+h)-psi(x)-h+sum_{rho in Z(Tstar)} m(rho)*((x+h)^rho-x^rho)/rho) <= (1447/500)/T*((x+h)*log(x+h)+x*log(x)).

supporting_lean_definitions.truncatedZeroIncrement:
noncomputable def truncatedZeroIncrement (x y T : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ ρ ∈ allZetaZeros T, (zetaMultiplicity ρ : ℂ) *
    (((y : ℂ) ^ ρ - (x : ℂ) ^ ρ) / ρ)
